question: In a certain code language, 'MEDIUM' is coded as "LDCGSK. What is the code for 'PREFER' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘MEDIUM' is coded as "LDCGSK’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7d0acf8918319beecd4a9ed9e72056b9302ce46f827023c4a8297879fe70ea.png] 

Similarly, for '**PREFER**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1df3e7ed66a91813bc34113f47f20dbbf38fb267d8d81c73939a01d3d775727b.png] 

So, 'PREFER' is coded as '**OQDDCP**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
